section_summary.extract_value: This section reports results from a single large online study of 9,667 Western women (US residents n = 8,925; non-US residents n = 742) who completed the YouBeauty Body Image Survey. Participants provided measures of weight-based body dissatisfaction, body appreciation, subjective happiness, and BMI; key findings were that 89.0% showed weight-based body dissatisfaction, body appreciation positively predicted subjective happiness, and BMI was negatively associated with body appreciation but had a direct positive association with subjective happiness. No study label such as 'Study 1' is used in the text.
